login.title: Email or Username
login.body: Adults log in with their email address. Children use a unique username within the family.

password.title: Password
password.body: Password must contain at least 10 characters to secure your family space.

familyName.title: Family Name
familyName.body: Displayed on the home dashboard. For example: 'Ivanov Family'.

familySlug.title: Family Code
familySlug.body: A unique short code used by children to sign in. Example: ivanov.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.body: Used for precise interest calculation and display times in audit logs.

preferredLocale.title: Interface Language
preferredLocale.body: Choose language for buttons, menus, tooltips, and system messages.

name.title: Bank Name
name.body: Helps the child distinguish this bank from others. E.g. 'Mom's Bank' or 'Bicycle Fund'.

description.title: Short Description
description.body: Optional explanation of why the bank was created and its terms.

interestRate.title: Interest Rate
interestRate.body: Percentage added to the deposit per accrual period. E.g. at 4% rate and 1,000 ₽ balance, interest will yield 1,040 ₽.

interestPeriodDays.title: Accrual Period
interestPeriodDays.body: How many days pass between interest accruals. With 14 days, interest compounds every two weeks.

minimumDeposit.title: Minimum Deposit Amount
minimumDeposit.body: A child cannot create a deposit with less than this amount.

maxLimitPerChild.title: Limit per Child
maxLimitPerChild.body: Maximum total balance a child can keep across deposits in this bank.

earlyWithdrawalPenalty.title: Early Withdrawal Penalty
earlyWithdrawalPenalty.body: If closed before the minimum term, the bank retains this percentage. An exact breakdown is displayed prior to confirmation.

minimumHoldingDays.title: Minimum Term
minimumHoldingDays.body: Number of days money must stay in the deposit to withdraw without penalty.

allowTopUp.title: Allow Top-up
allowTopUp.body: If enabled, the child can submit top-up requests to adults for open deposits.

minTopUp.title: Minimum Top-up Amount
minTopUp.body: Top-up requests below this amount cannot be submitted.

maxTopUp.title: Maximum Top-up Amount
maxTopUp.body: Single top-up requests cannot exceed this amount.

maxDepositBalance.title: Deposit Balance Limit
maxDepositBalance.body: Maximum balance for a single deposit including initial deposit, top-ups, and interest.

accrualMode.title: Interest Accrual Mode
accrualMode.body: Simple: interest calculates on the full balance on the accrual date. Realistic: each top-up compounds after its own period from approval.

brandIcon.title: Bank Icon
brandIcon.body: Emoji shown to the child on bank and deposit cards.

brandColor.title: Brand Color
brandColor.body: Helps distinguish the bank in lists and charts. Does not affect calculations.

amount.title: Deposit Amount
amount.body: Initial principal starting the deposit. Must comply with minimum deposit and bank limits.

goalName.title: Goal Title
goalName.body: What the child is saving for: e.g. 'New Bicycle' or 'Lego Set'.

goalAmount.title: Goal Target Amount
goalAmount.body: The system displays progress towards this target.

goalDate.title: Target Date
goalDate.body: Optional target date. Does not affect interest rate.

amount.title: Top-up Amount
amount.body: Amount the child wants to add to an active deposit.

amount.title: Reward Amount
amount.body: Direct bonus from an adult credited immediately to the deposit.

reason.title: Reward Reason
reason.body: E.g.: 'For great school grades' or 'Helping around the house'.

confirm.title: Closing Deposit
confirm.body: Closing early may incur a penalty fee according to bank terms.

period.title: Period
period.body: Frequency of interest payments in days.

inviteEmail.title: Adult's Email
inviteEmail.body: An invitation link will be sent to this email address.

childUsername.title: Child's Username
childUsername.body: Used alongside the family code to sign in.

transferOwner.title: Transfer Family Ownership
transferOwner.body: The family owner controls family settings and administrator rights. Irreversible action!

filterDate.title: Date Filter
filterDate.body: Allows reviewing security audit events for a specific timeframe.

filterEvent.title: Event Type
filterEvent.body: Select specific events: bank creation, top-up, login, etc.
